summary: Domain sfrc.ca and www.sfrc.ca both 301-redirect to https://lamontagnegf.ca/, which serves a static 'Lamontagne — Groupe financier' landing page (Quebec financial services firm). This is no longer a firearms retail site. The domain appears to have been allowed to lapse and re-registered (or DNS reassigned) to a different business entity. No firearm catalog content remains on any path.

wwwGetFollowed.bodyContent: Static 'site under construction' page for a Quebec financial services firm offering insurance brokerage, mortgage brokerage, investments (REER/CELI/etc.), and estate planning. Contact at 222 rue Simoneau, Thetford Mines, QC. No e-commerce, no products, no firearms-related content.

stage2_wafProbe.result: Probe ran cleanly against canonical destination (lamontagnegf.ca). All 8 batches returned HTTP 200 with consistent ~110ms timing, no challenge bodies, no cf-ray, no x-sucuri, no Incapsula, no SiteGround. Server header: nginx. WAF probe outcome would be 'hasWaf: false (HIGH confidence)' for the destination site — but the destination is not the target site; the target domain is defunct/repurposed.

recommendation: Mark sfrc.ca as defunct in the seed list. If the user wants firearm-retail data from a former SFRC location, that operator must be re-located by name (initials unknown) on a current domain. Pre-bootstrap cannot proceed against a domain that no longer hosts firearms retail content.
judgmentCalls: Confirmed apex and www return identical bodies (cmp -s match) - both redirect to lamontagnegf.ca via nginx 301.

Verified the destination is not merely a temporarily-parked domain by reading the body: it has unique business content (operator name, address in Thetford Mines, QC, listed services in French, contact phone +1-581-333-2828, copyright Lamontagne groupe financier). This is an actively-served business site, not a registrar parking page.

Tested 5 legacy firearm-retail-shaped paths (/shop, /products, /store, /wp-json/wp/v2/product, /sitemap.xml). All redirect to identically-shaped paths on lamontagnegf.ca; none reveal any residual firearm content.
